description.zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号。
description.en: The ID of the member. If you specify a value for this parameter, you can query the bills of the specified member. If you leave this parameter empty, the bills of the current account are queried by default.
The billing cycle, in the YYYY-MM format.

description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   Subscription: the subscription billing method
*   PayAsYouGo: the pay-as-you-go billing method
